normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private heated pool **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $40 per day**- Peloton bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Low-Speed Vehicle- Stunning views- Private beach access- 5 adult bikes- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Indulge in laid-back, Gulf-front luxury at the stunning Toro Azul. This posh 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home hosts up to 12 guests. Located in beloved Seacrest Beach, guests are minutes from restaurants, shopping, and live entertainment at nearby WaterSound and Alys Beach. Enjoy sun-drenched days playing ping-pong by the private pool, dining alongside views of the Gulf, or strolling down the dedicated beach access—right off the back deck!A peaceful living space welcomes guests on the first floor of this 3-story home. Lounge with loved ones on the plush L-shaped sofa, set before an inviting fireplace and 65” TV. Refreshments are steps away, thanks to the dry bar, equipped with a beverage fridge and microwave. Sneak in a quick workout using the provided Peloton bike, or enjoy a yoga flow outside beside the rippling pool. A ping-pong table, chaise lounges, grill, and 4-person table complete the deck. Savor days in the sun surrounded by sprawling Gulf views, with the beach a short stroll away via the private walkover. At bedtime, a bunk room boasting 2 twin-over-twin beds is perfect for kids and young adults. For convenience, a washer and dryer are down the hall.Venture upstairs to discover an opulent coastal living space, defined by oversized windows and alluring Gulf views. An intimate arrangement of soft couches and armchairs invites lively nights of conversation or comfy movie viewing. The adjacent kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring a spacious island with 3 stools, an 8-burner double oven gas range, and a French door refrigerator in the butler’s pantry. Host friends and family around the circular table for 6, set beneath a dramatic, modern chandelier. From the living room, access the wraparound deck with an alfresco 8-seat dining table and a high-top table for 4—ideal for enjoying the vivid sunrise with a rich cup of coffee.A lovely primary bedroom on the third floor features a king bed and a private balcony with a porch swing and chairs, where guests can capture Gulf views. Also on this floor are 1 bunk room with a twin-over-twin bunk and 2 guest bedrooms with a queen and king bed, respectively.Gulf-front decadence awaits at Toro Azul in Seacrest! With on-site parking for 2 vehicles, 5 adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle, it’s a breeze to get around. Book this incredible home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunks, Shared Bathroom Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
